facts.business: Galaxy Supermarket Limited (formerly Galaxy Cloud Kitchens Limited) operates in the supermarket retail business after discontinuing its cloud kitchen operations.

auditor.name: Yogesh Kansal & Company
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern (net worth fully eroded, current liabilities exceed current assets); Emphasis of Matters: discontinued operations at Bangalore, Mumbai, Gurugram commissary units; write-back of unclaimed creditors Rs 82.16 lakh including Rs 50.52 lakh MSME interest provision without waiver confirmation; write-back of Rs 53.39 lakh inter-corporate loan interest provision; investment properties not separately classified per Ind AS 40; trade payables to MSMEs settled without interest payment.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to fully eroded net worth and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Discontinued operations from commissary units at Bangalore, Mumbai and Gurugram
Write-back of creditor provisions without formal waiver confirmations
Non-compliance with Ind AS 40 for investment property classification
Settlement of MSME payables without payment of statutory interest
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with Aadhar Retailing Limited (entity under common group control) approved for aggregate value not exceeding Rs 4,525 lakh during FY 2026-27. Write-back of Rs 53.39 lakh interest provision on inter-corporate loan from related party after receiving waiver letter.
